introduction.title: Schedule SQL inside a running DuckDB process
paragraphs: Cronjob runs SQL repeatedly according to a cron expression. A scheduled statement can refresh a summary table, export results, or perform another task in a DuckDB process that is already running.

The schedule belongs to that process and lives in memory. Closing DuckDB removes the jobs, so this fits a persistent application or service. For a CLI command that should start on a schedule, use an external scheduler to launch DuckDB.
